title: A Microeconomic Finance Model with a Multi-Asset Market and a Multi-Investor Heterogeneous Groups
summary: We present a mathematical model of a market with $m$ shares traded across $n$ investor groups, each one with similar motivations and trading strategies. The market of each asset consists of a fixed amount of cash and shares (no additions are allowed over time, so the system is closed), and the trading groups are influenced by trend and valuation motivations when buying or selling each asset, but follow a strategy where the purchase of one asset depends on the price of another, while the sale does not.
